shortDescription: Modify SMTP configuration on HyperCore API.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password if SMTP server requires authentication. Required together with I(auth_user).

options.name: auth_user
options.description: Username if SMTP server requires authentication. Required together with I(auth_password).

options.name: from_address
options.description: Email address the system alerts will be sent from.

options.name: port
options.description: TCP port number of the SMTP server. This parameter B(must always) be provided.

options.name: server
options.description: IP address or hostname of the SMTP server. This parameter B(must always) be provided.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Enable/disable SSL encryption. Using SSL is recommended to avoid sending login information in clear text. Ensure the SMTP server supports SSL/TLS connections.
